description: N-1 variant of sel_v3 (make_nm1_configs.py): no muon identification requirement (loose muons of the records)

muon.id: AN tight: PF muon, or the tracker high-pT ID above high_pt_alternative_above (h4l::an_tight_muon); loose part from h4l_reco

leptons.isolation: AN 3.3 FSR-subtracted relative isolation in dR < 0.3 (h4l::fsr_in_isolation)

regions.name: SR
regions.comment: the H signal region (AN 4.3 with the Z2 minimum optimized on MC: 10 GeV); the smart cut uses the same Z2 threshold

regions.name: SRZ4l
regions.comment: the Z -> 4l selection of the paper (m_Z2 > 4 GeV; 80 < m4l < 100 GeV applied downstream); the smart cut uses the same Z2 threshold

zl.comment: Z + 1 loose lepton of AN 7.2.1.1 (Z1 closest to m_Z within z1_mass); the fake-rate window |m_Z1 - m_Z| < 7 GeV, MET < 25 GeV and the SS-method windows are applied downstream

jets.comment: DeepJet medium (UL16 post-VFP) by the user decision of 2026-09-24; jets cleaned from the selected leptons and their FSR photons

categories.comment: paper working points (JHEP 11 (2017) 047 section 6) with the MELA normalization; D_WH and D_ZH with the constants derived on MC; applied downstream
